---
title: "simstim rm"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Delete a session, after a question.

```text
simstim rm [<host>/<session>|-] [flags]
```

**Aliases:** `delete`

Stops the session's agent and removes the session from the host. The session's folder stays. A worktree that the session made goes with its branch, unless it has changes or new commits. At a terminal, rm asks first, and without a session it lets you pick one from a list. The host may be left out when no other host has a session of that name.

## Examples

```sh
simstim rm my-vps/auth-fix
simstim rm my-vps/auth-fix -y   # no question, as in a script
simstim rm auth-fix             # the host is found when the name is unique
simstim rm                      # pick one from a list
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `-y`, `--yes` | answer yes to every question: delete the session |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |
